sloka: स वारिधारा इव सायकांस्तान् पिबन् शरीरेण महेन्द्रशत्रुः।जघान रामस्य शरप्रवेगं व्याविध्य तं मुद्गरमुग्रवेगम् ।। ६.६७.१४२ ।।
transliteration: sa vāridhārā iva sāyakāṁstān piban śarīreṇa mahendraśatruḥ।jaghāna rāmasya śarapravegaṁ vyāvidhya taṁ mudgaramugravegam ।। 6.67.142 ।।

translations.english: (Kumbhakarna) Adorned with gold armlets, blood flowing from his mouth was like a rain cloud showering from Vindhya or Mandara mountain.
